_comment: PreToolUse hooks enforce rules that CLAUDE.md cannot guarantee. CLAUDE.md gives ~70% compliance. These hooks give 100%. Add a hook here for any rule where a violation is unacceptable, not just undesirable.

hooks._comment: Blocks any bash command that directly references /var/run/docker.sock or calls 'docker' CLI in ways that bypass the proxy. Agents should use Executor tool calls, not raw docker commands.

Blocks any 'git push' targeting main or 'git merge' into main. The merge gate in the LangGraph graph handles this with a Telegram interrupt; this hook is the fallback if Claude tries to do it via bash.

Blocks pip install, apt install, brew install, npm install -g, and similar commands run outside of a container context. All package installs happen inside workspace containers via Executor.run_command().
Runs gitleaks on the file content before it is written. Blocks the write if a credential pattern is detected. Catches accidental secret writes before they reach disk.

Blocks writes to any file outside services/executor/ that would introduce an import of the Docker SDK (docker, docker.from_env, DockerClient). Enforces the 'only Executor touches Docker' rule at the file-write level.
